finding: The fix-iteration prompt template of the Gate-Check Loop does not fit a run by hand, although step 5 of the run by hand sends the gate-check step to that loop. The template tells the fresh developer agent 'Your worktree was prepared by dispatch' and 'Fix the gate failures on branch <feature-branch>'. By hand there is no worktree, and the developer agent works on story/ST-NNNN in the primary checkout. The story rewrote the other two prompts for a run by hand, and both name story/ST-NNNN, so this third prompt is the only one left with the old wording. An agent that fills <feature-branch> with feature/login sends the retry to the wrong branch. The smallest fix is in implementation-agent.md: name the branch story/ST-NNNN in the template and say where the agent works on each way, as the fix prompt of the story workflow does.
why_this_severity: dispatch verify-story checks with git branch --contains that each reported commit lies on the story branch, so a retry committed on the feature branch is refused before any merge (no to fails_purpose). The refused retry still costs a counted attempt and a second spawn, and the developer agent must work out the right branch alone.
